auth_banner.hero_desc: See yourself in ancient Rome, 1920s Paris, or futuristic Tokyo. AI-powered time travel visualization that puts you in the scene.
auth_banner.premium_highlight_desc: Experience history in stunning detail. Our quantum rendering engine uses Gemini 3 Pro to generate photorealistic environments with accurate historical lighting and textures.
auth_banner.data_private: Your data is private & encrypted. 5 free generations included.

features.photo_restoration_desc: Breathe new life into old, damaged photos. AI repairs scratches, tears, and fading while enhancing to 16K DSLR quality with vivid colors.
features.pixar_3d_desc: Transform yourself or groups into charming Pixar/Disney-style 3D characters with expressive faces, cinematic lighting, and vibrant scenes.
features.group_travel_desc: Bring the whole crew. Upload up to 14 people, celebrities, or pets to appear together in any historical or futuristic scene.
features.art_styles_desc: Photorealistic 8K, Cyberpunk, Oil Painting, Vintage Film, Photo Book, Cinematic Grid, CCTV, Aerial Drone, and more. Render up to 4K.
features.terminal_desc: Navigate spacetime with conversation. Simply type "Take us to Paris in 1920" and the AI interprets your intent instantly.
features.community_desc: Join travellers from all over the world. Share your journeys, discover new eras, and explore the infinite possibilities of spacetime together.

terms.storage_desc: Time Traveller uses secure storage protocols to save your generated images, audio logs, and travel history. To maintain system efficiency and privacy:
terms.free_tier_desc: All travel data (images, audio, logs) for free users is stored for a maximum of 3 days.
terms.purge_desc: After this period, data is automatically purged from our quantum archives to free up storage sectors.
terms.download_recommend: We recommend downloading any important visual records to your local device immediately after your journey.
terms.upgrade_desc: Upgrade your clearance level to access extended features:
terms.privacy_desc: We do not sell your personal data or travel logs to third-party timelines. Your uploaded reference photos are processed solely for the purpose of generating your requested visualization and are not used for training public AI models without your explicit consent.

tour.step1_desc: Travel anywhere in the universe across any time period. Use Manual mode for quick input, or Terminal for natural language commands.
tour.step1_feature1: 🌍 Earth locations (Paris, Tokyo, Pyramids of Giza)
tour.step1_feature2: 🚀 Space & planets (Mars Colony, Moon Base, Saturn Rings)
tour.step1_highlight: Try: 'Eiffel Tower in 1920' or coordinates '35.6762, 139.6503' for Tokyo
tour.step2_desc: Upload a selfie or take a photo to be placed into your destination! The AI will seamlessly integrate you into any location, era, or world you choose.
tour.step2_feature1: 📸 Upload from device or take a live photo
tour.step2_feature4: 🎨 Choose visual styles: Realistic, Cyberpunk, Oil Painting & more
tour.step2_highlight: Click the profile icon next to 'Engage Teleport' to add your photo
tour.step3_desc: After teleporting, explore your AI-generated destination with audio narration, download high-resolution images, and revisit past journeys in your Temporal Archives.
tour.step3_feature1: 🔊 AI audio guide describes your surroundings
tour.step3_feature2: 💾 Download 8K images to share with friends
tour.step3_feature3: 📚 All journeys saved in Temporal Archives
tour.step3_feature4: 🗺️ Open locations in Google Street View
tour.step3_highlight: Your history is private and stored securely in your account
